decls.name: CyclicCubicSubfieldTotallyReal

paper_span.quote: of $\mathbb Q(\zeta_r)$ is totally real, has conductor $r$, and is ramified only at $r$.

decls.rationale: The totally-real clause of Proposition A.11: the unique cyclic cubic subfield of \(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_r)\), \(r \equiv 1 \pmod 3\), is totally real.
